title: Effectiveness and implementation of digital health interventions in rural healthcare: A protocol of a review of reviews
content:
by Piao Wang, Laurie Peebles, Aine O’Connor, Christina Beall, Julie Honey, Yongsheng Wang, Xinrong Li

Introduction

The purpose of this review of reviews is to synthesize and critically evaluate existing systematic, scoping, integrative, and rapid reviews examining digital health interventions in rural healthcare settings. By examining effectiveness alongside implementation processes, barriers, facilitators, and contextual conditions, this review seeks to identify recurring implementation factors and their reported relationships with outcomes in rural systems.

Materials and methods

This review will follow the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) methodology for umbrella reviews, adapted to the included review types. Searches will cover MEDLINE (PubMed), CINAHL (EBSCOhost), SCOPUS (Elsevier), Embase (Elsevier), and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL). PROSPERO and the Open Science Framework will be searched to identify ongoing reviews. Eligible reviews must synthesize quantitative, qualitative, or mixed-methods research on digital health interventions in rural settings. Mixed-population reviews will be eligible when rural findings are separately extractable. Two reviewers will independently screen records, extract data, and appraise reviews, with unresolved disagreements adjudicated by a third reviewer. AMSTAR 2 will assess systematic intervention reviews within its scope; prespecified project-specific criteria will assess other eligible reviews. Primary-study overlap will be examined using a citation matrix and corrected covered area where calculable. The updated Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research and the Reach, Effectiveness, Adoption, Implementation, and Maintenance framework will guide implementation synthesis. Health outcomes and access to care will be the principal effectiveness domains. Findings will be grouped by clinical context and outcome domain and summarized in tables and narratively.

Dissemination

Results will be disseminated in peer-reviewed publications and professional conferences.

Protocol registration

The protocol was registered with PROSPERO on 11 April 2026 with the registration number CRD420261365627 (https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261365627).
